installation_contract.validation: official controller and independently authenticated backend adapter

turn_stop.rule: UX-09: user or unknown interrupts the current turn, model closes it; a user stop is never downgraded. No context, continuation signal or veto is emitted; the outcome is stored. Records for an interrupted turn are rejected with turn_interrupted. The next prompt carries prior_turn in its response file.

optional.tool_type: Verified project-local runtime-type root name above the installation UID; dedicated guidance is tool_dedicated_instructions.md in that root
optional.timezone: project calendar timezone, defaults to UTC
optional.adoption_checkpoint: Absolute reference to the already mapped owned JSON checkpoint. The controller never advances adoption.

instruction_sources.organization: Scoped operations layer locator or explicit null
instruction_sources.workspace: Scoped common private layer locator or explicit null

operations_binding.profile: identifier of a distributed version control binding profile
operations_binding.entries: Up to 16 {entry, key, value} repository-scoped configuration entries recorded and verified at bootstrap; values are non-secret references, never credential bytes

registration.authority: The installation owns the root declarative adapter and registration and independently observes machine-local storage. Event data cannot choose the project, checkout, source or registration.

governed_fields.required_when: record level G2, G3 or G4 in planning, execution or verification without technical_adoption

output.native: A bounded mandatory acquisition instruction names the immutable response. Authorized acquisition and validation remain reachable; equivalent material dependencies do not restart recovery. Acquire the complete identified definition closure before dependent effects; reuse only currently available verified context. Root-first acquire supplies finite correlated complete segments under existing authority.
output.silent: A decoded turn_stop emits its declared context-free template; an undecoded native event emits empty output with exit 0. Both outcomes are stored; undecoded ones are counted in unbound_diagnostics at the next session opening or prompt.
output.direct: record and snapshot return the complete result in context; additionalContext is a one-line outcome and never duplicates context. procedure carries its identity and dynamic parts; native responses identify complete immutable shared definitions with deterministic lossless shallow-merge resolution.
output.assurance: Context only. Independent host authorization, actual capability and effect observation govern work.

input.offset: next expected UTF-8 byte offset, initially 0

acquisition.output: oop_context_acquisition with partial/complete status, stable transaction, dependency and reconstructed content identities, offset/next_offset/total_bytes and content; failure has bounded diagnostic and resumption condition. Completion validates available bytes only. Unknown fields, foreign/expired targets, wrong offsets, changed dependencies and interrupted turns cannot succeed. Acquisition performs only owned reads and correlated bookkeeping; it grants no host exception.

definitions.resolution: Verify content identity over complete definition bytes. Merge top-level fields and each object-valued top-level field once; explicit delta fields replace base fields. Arrays, types, string contents and absent/null distinctions remain exact. Missing definitions leave context incomplete.

session_store.session_file: <session_key>.json: bounded state, up to 16 indexed responses and up to 16 recent diagnostics
session_store.response_file: <session_key>/<response_id>.json, written once per native invocation and never rewritten; unbound/<response_id>.json when no session identity is available
session_store.session_key: the native chat identity when it is a lowercase filename-safe identifier that is not a reserved device or store name, otherwise h- plus its sha256
session_store.format: compact UTF-8 JSON with structural newlines and every line at most 4096 bytes; no string normalization or semantic loss; output_invalid otherwise
session_store.pruning: At every native write, under the session lock: orphan temporary files, idle sessions beyond expiry, oversize files, responses outside the index older than the minimum window, then the oldest inactive sessions beyond the count or byte budget. The current session, sessions active within the minimum window and indexed responses are never removed; an unreachable budget reports over_soft_limit instead of refusing a session.
session_store.errors: Native diagnostics are appended to the session errors list with their response_id; direct command diagnostics are returned only on standard output. No acknowledgment command exists; the runtime presents each diagnostic with its effective-language translation.

adapter.input: bounded UTF-8 JSON on standard input

context_delivery.scope: Each native response declares mode and official documentation basis for the actual host and version.

modes.preview: Declare preamble and visible_prefix_bytes for the decoded context. The controller prepends the preamble and line break before encoding the full payload once.
modes.separate: Provide the recovery instruction through a documented visible channel and identify it in the basis.
modes.unavailable: Record the precise limitation and withhold dependent work.
modes.none: turn_stop only: no placeholder and no context; the declared stdout, stderr and nonblocking exit_code are emitted unchanged.

context_delivery.recovery: Read the full context through the current host-provided reference before substantive responses or dependent effects, within existing authority. Report incomplete retrieval and continue independent authorized work.

adapter.record_exit: 0 only for an explicit accepted receipt; otherwise 1. Inspect correlation.
adapter.implementation: Fixed declarative scaffold; controller-owned loading, dispatch and native rendering.

diagnostics.rejection: diagnostic.code, diagnostic.items[{field, rule, expected, received}] and diagnostic.remedy; transition rejections add diagnostic.current{turn, version, subject_state, allowed_states}
diagnostics.received: type and length for strings outside a closed set, the value for closed-set strings, integers and booleans; never free text
diagnostics.recovery: Optional busy_phase identifies observed contention without changing the disposition. Reconcile current owned state and submission receipts before a bounded retry; preserve live or unverifiable locks. Exact retained request replays without mutation, changed payload conflicts.
diagnostics.limits: No raw prompts, secrets or stacks. Unknown root or unwritable storage remains an explicit limitation named in the delivered instruction.

submission.accepted: context.status=record_accepted and correlated context.receipt.disposition=accepted; first version=expected_version+1
submission.duplicate: Same retained request_id and identical payload reuses its receipt within the same turn; different payload is correlation_conflict.
submission.recovery: Snapshot reads current state and bounded receipts without advancing a turn or synchronization. Resolve uncertain outcome before retry; missing expired receipt is not failure proof.
submission.timing: Each new subject, including G0, before substantive response or dependent effects; reclassify scope changes and record applicable transitions. Continuation reuses subject, with current turn/version.
submission.authority: Attributed technical claims only; no effect permission, artificial G0 ticket or raw prompt persistence.

declaration.record_identity: identity of canonical serialized extracted knowledge record
declaration.input_coverage: current context.knowledge_input.reference must be classified in the actual record

knowledge.content_identity: sha256: plus hexadecimal digest of complete profile bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization
knowledge.profile_header: first fenced block with info string oop-profile containing one format-2 JSON object and immutable provenance; no current separate owner review
knowledge.record: knowledge member of a JSON work item or the single fenced oop-knowledge JSON block

controller.verified: declaration, actual work-item record, current input coverage, index, actual profile bytes and evidence dependency bindings consistent; receipt.knowledge.status=verified
controller.unverified_store_unavailable: index unreadable or invalid; accepted without knowledge verification and disclosed in receipt.knowledge.status
controller.rejection_output: non-accepted record with diagnostic.code, diagnostic.items and diagnostic.remedy on standard output; never a host denial

gates.execution: every required step has a disposition

controller.context: context.knowledge_input at every prompt; context.knowledge_obligations resolves bounded relevant retained subjects and current work-item obligations, versioned plan, provenance and gaps before reclassification; never profile text or raw prompts

validator.output: one UTF-8 JSON object {validator, format, command, valid, errors[{code,item}]}
validator.effects: offline; never mutates inputs; only index --write replaces the derived index
validator.boundary: R14 independent pre-publication validation; separate from the nonblocking context controller

daily.trigger: first supported session opening or prompt outside bootstrap
daily.migration: Deliver the synchronized target and lifecycle and migration locators to the runtime. The runtime executes applicable procedures under existing authority and retains its separately verified adoption checkpoint.

operations_binding.check: At session opening and at the first prompt of the day, a read-only comparison of the operations repository-scoped configuration with the recorded registration binding
operations_binding.effect: Informational only: never blocks the host and never repairs; the runtime restores drifted entries under current authority before effects on operations.

history.data: Turn, turn state (active, interrupted, closed), procedure state, governance level, ticket relation and bounded canonical routing facets. Raw prompt, transcript and credentials are excluded.
history.stale_writer: Turn and version must match before a reachable subject state update; exact retained replay never advances state.

delivery: Abstract interoperable contract; native/local interfaces suffice. No mandatory interpreter product, integration protocol, policy engine or hosted service.

evidence.authority: A supplied fact requires independent attributable scope-bound evidence; shape or a true boolean is not proof.

checkpoints.cardinality: One authoritative logical current adoption checkpoint per initialized workspace/persistent-runtime key; zero before initialization, no competing current authority.
checkpoints.discovery: Resolve authorized topology mapping before adoption discovery or creation; unknown ownership blocks dependent scope, never creates a session-derived fallback.
checkpoints.write: Use applicable expected-revision/concurrency and atomic persistence; atomic rename alone does not prevent lost updates.
checkpoints.reuse: Require exact relevant dependencies and current ownership/freshness; workspace switch invalidates active project state.
